messages:
sachin: FYI customer reported intermittent 500s + slow tokenization on /v1/generate. They attached a debug bundle but it has raw prompts and user emails — do NOT share externally. Need a scrubbed debug bundle + minimal curl repro. tagging @security and @maria

maria: Thanks. Can you drop the request_id and a sample curl (sanitized) here? Also which customer (redacted name ok) and billing org id so we can match logs?

sachin: request_id: req_3f9a****b2e (masked). Customer alias: "acme-corp" (redacted). Billing org: org-1234 (redacted). Attached a sanitized curl below — please confirm it looks sufficient to repro: 

sachin: ```
# sanitized curl to reproduce 500s (prompt content replaced)
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED_TOKEN]" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-std-1","input":"[SANITIZED_PROMPT]","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.0}'
```

kelly: grabbing logs now. Oncall bot shows spikes at 2025-11-04T15:12Z for that request_id. Can you also remove any PII in the prompt payloads (emails, phone numbers, filenames)? 

oncall-bot: notice: instance gpu-12 reported OOM-warning and retry path triggered for req_3f9a****b2e; latency 2.1s -> 18.3s after retry. (automated)

security: Quick scrub checklist — keep structure but replace sensitive tokens with placeholders. Examples to replace: email@domain.com -> [EMAIL], 0xabcdef1234 -> [HEX_ID], /home/alice/docs -> [FILE_PATH], credit card-like sequences -> [REDACTED_CC]. For bundles: run jq to strip user meta and then gzip. Example commands: 

security: ```
# remove user.email and user.phone from JSON bundle
jq 'del(.events[]?.user.email, .events[]?.user.phone, .sessions[].user_meta)' debug-bundle.json > debug-bundle.sanitized.json
# mask long ids (simple sed example)
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}/[LONG_ID]/g' debug-bundle.sanitized.json > debug-bundle.final.json
```

maria: That looks good. Two asks: 1) include a minimal curl that reproduces the error with prompt replaced (you did) and 2) upload the sanitized bundle to the support S3 bucket with path support/acme-corp/1764509876-sanitized.json and post the link here. Also note whether the bundle still triggers the 500 locally for eng/runtime.

sachin: uploading now to s3://support-acme/sanitized/1764509876-sanitized.json (internal link). I ran the sanitized curl against staging and got a 500 with stack trace pointing to tokenization::encode_loop in the runtime. Pasted minimal stack excerpt below (sanitized):

sachin: ```
ERROR tokenization::encode_loop at runtime/src/tokenizer.rs:312
thread "worker-4" panicked at 'index out of bounds', src/runtime/kv_cache.rs:89
caused by: invalid sequence length for model redwood-std-1
```

kelly: forwarding to eng-runtime with the sanitized bundle + curl. tagging @maria for follow up on billing impact. 

maria: thanks all. Security — can you sign off on the sanitized bundle so we can share with the runtime team externally if needed? If approved, I'll create a short incident ticket with repro steps and attach the scrubbed bundle. :thumbsup:

security: signed off for external share after we rotate the customer token and verify no creds remain. Please rotate tokens and then proceed.

sachin: noted — rotated token and updated bundle timestamp. I'll update the ticket once eng confirms repro. Thanks everyone :)
